links.outcome: Detection of images where segmentation model failed using Mahalanobis distance on PCA-reduced bottleneck features
links.effect: Achieved 92% AUROC and 94% AUPRC for detecting failed images; runs in seconds on a CPU.
links.quote: Specifically, the proposed technique achieved 92% area under the receiver operating characteristic curve and 94% area under the precision-recall curve and can run in seconds on a central processing unit.

links.outcome: Out-of-distribution image detection at inference for a deployed segmentation model
links.effect: Post hoc Mahalanobis distance with PCA detected failed images with 92% AUROC and 94% AUPRC.
links.quote: By reducing the dimensions of the bottleneck features with principal component analysis, images the model failed on were detected with high performance and minimal computational load.
